# coolify_volume_backup (Resource)

A backup schedule for a persistent storage (`coolify_storage`) of an application, service or database. One schedule per storage (server-side upsert).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "coolify_volume_backup" "uploads" {
  parent_type     = "application"
  parent_uuid     = coolify_application.web.uuid
  storage_uuid    = coolify_storage.uploads.uuid
  frequency       = "@daily"
  save_s3         = true
  s3_storage_uuid = coolify_s3_storage.backups.uuid
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `frequency` (String) Cron expression or shorthand (`@daily`…).
- `parent_type` (String) `application`, `service` or `database`. Changing it forces replacement.
- `parent_uuid` (String) UUID of the parent resource. Changing it forces replacement.
- `storage_uuid` (String) UUID of the `coolify_storage` to back up. Changing it forces replacement.

### Optional

- `disable_local_backup` (Boolean) Skip keeping a local copy. Defaults to `false`.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the schedule is active. Defaults to `true`.
- `retention_amount_locally` (Number) Number of local backups to keep (0 = unlimited).
- `retention_amount_s3` (Number) Number of S3 backups to keep (0 = unlimited).
- `retention_days_locally` (Number) Days to keep local backups (0 = unlimited).
- `retention_days_s3` (Number) Days to keep S3 backups (0 = unlimited).
- `s3_storage_uuid` (String) UUID of the `coolify_s3_storage` target (required when `save_s3`).
- `save_s3` (Boolean) Ship backups to S3. Defaults to `false`.
- `stop_during_backup` (Boolean) Stop the resource while the volume is snapshotted. Defaults to `false`.
- `timeout` (Number) Backup timeout in seconds (60–36000).

### Read-Only

- `uuid` (String) Server-assigned identifier of the schedule.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The API has no read endpoint for volume backup schedules (PUT-only upsert),
# so importing only establishes which storage the schedule belongs to — its
# attributes (frequency, retention, ...) are populated by the next apply.
terraform import coolify_volume_backup.example <parent_type>/<parent_uuid>/<storage_uuid>

# parent_type is "application", "service" or "database".
```
